stemMd: Which statement must be true in every permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Library and Island must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Harbour and Island must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Harbour and Island must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Harbour and Market must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Combine the ordering and placement constraints rather than assuming one example is unique. The statement "Library and Island must not occupy consecutive positions." holds in all 2 permitted orders. Generate the cases by placing any fixed-position item and adjacent block first, then discard arrangements that violate a remaining rule. For each alternative, an explicit permitted counterexample appears in its feedback.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Island → Market → Harbour → Library → Park
- Market → Island → Harbour → Library → Park

distractorRationale.c: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Market → Island → Harbour → Library → Park. Thus this statement is not necessary.
distractorRationale.d: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Market → Island → Harbour → Library → Park. Thus this statement is not necessary.
distractorRationale.b: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Island → Market → Harbour → Library → Park. Thus this statement is not necessary.

independentSolve.workingNotes: Blind re-solve in the 5 November 2026 AI audit of this expansion (the review packet held no key, explanation or distractor notes; status "verified_key_agreement"; it checked for competing defensible answers and flagged none): Independently enumerated all 120 permutations of Harbour, Island, Library, Market, Park. Rules Library must occur after Harbour and before Park. Island and Market must occupy consecutive positions, in either order. Harbour must not be in position 1. leave 2 valid orders: Island>Market>Harbour>Library>Park; Market>Island>Harbour>Library>Park. Choice true counts: a=1, b=1, c=2, d=1; necessary requires all matches.
